## Featured Projects
- [Timenotes](https://lutfiikbalmajid.pages.dev/project/timenotes): Offline-first cross-platform developer notes and time tracker built with React Native and SQLite.
- [KendaliAI](https://lutfiikbalmajid.pages.dev/project/kendaliai): Enterprise multi-agent orchestration console with real-time telemetry, model routing, and role delegation.
- [ForgeADE](https://lutfiikbalmajid.pages.dev/project/forgeade): Native developer environment and terminal workspace built with Go and Wails v2.
- [MyAiRouter](https://lutfiikbalmajid.pages.dev/project/myairouter): Ultra-low footprint AI Gateway and model load balancer in Go with sub-20ms proxy latency.
